description: 3-stage mass assignment via GORM JSON column persistence toggle (markModified port): (1) add a Preferences TEXT field to Account for extensible user preferences (theme, locale, notifications) + GET /api/v1/accounts/:id/preferences endpoint, (2) add PATCH /api/v1/accounts/:id/preferences that deserialises, merges via map iteration, re-serialises and calls db.Updates(&account) -- but GORM struct-based Updates() does not detect changes to string fields that were loaded then reassigned (same-snapshot issue), (3) fix persistence by switching to db.Model(&account).Update("preferences", prefsJSON) -- THE VULNERABILITY: arbitrary user-controlled JSON now persists, enabling privilege escalation via unvalidated preference keys.
